## Activity 1 {.center background-color="#002147"}

### Write down the name of the different data tools/apps/software that you and your team uses on a day-to-day basis

::: {.notes}

* Write down the name on a metacard or sticky note.

* Be as specific as possible.

* Ideally, write down the exact name/brand name of the product/tool/app/software.

:::

## Activity 2 {.center background-color="#002147"}

### With the metacards or sticky notes that you have made, post them on the board or wall and put them under the appropriate technology category

::: {.notes}

* If one product/tool/app/software is used for multiple categories, write new metacards or sticky notes for that product/tool/app/software to put under the respective categories.

:::
